pending.zh_CN: 请求已提交，仍需确认最终状态，当前不能视为已完成。
pending.en_US: The request has been submitted. Check the final status before treating it as complete.

messages.zh_CN: 本页包含 {{count}} 条可读消息。

empty_messages.zh_CN: 本页没有可展示的消息正文。
empty_messages.en_US: This page has no message text to display.

truncated.en_US: Only part of the content is shown in this detail.

omitted.zh_CN: 已过滤 {{count}} 条无正文或不可展示的消息。
omitted.en_US: {{count}} messages with no text or hidden content were filtered out.

partial_success.zh_CN: 部分文件处理失败，请查看各文件状态。
partial_success.en_US: Some files could not be processed. Check each file’s status.

more.zh_CN: 还有更多记录，本页不代表全部内容。
more.en_US: More records are available. This page does not contain all content.

no_more.zh_CN: 当前查询已无更多记录。
no_more.en_US: No more records are reported for this query.

error.default.zh_CN: 操作未完成，请检查权限或稍后重试。
error.default.en_US: The operation could not be completed. Check your access or try again later.

error.authorization_required.zh_CN: 当前会话缺少身份信息，请重新打开会话后重试。
error.authorization_required.en_US: Identity information is missing from this session. Reopen the session and try again.

error.authorization_failed.zh_CN: 当前账号无权访问此内容。
error.authorization_failed.en_US: Your account does not have access to this content.

error.service_rejected.zh_CN: 服务未接受本次操作，请检查目标内容与操作权限。
error.service_rejected.en_US: The service did not accept this operation. Check the target content and your access.

error.network_error.zh_CN: 暂时无法连接服务，请稍后重试。
error.network_error.en_US: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.

error.outcome_unknown.zh_CN: 尚无法确认操作是否生效，请先查询当前状态，避免重复提交。
error.outcome_unknown.en_US: The outcome could not be confirmed. Check the current status before submitting again.

error.invalid_input_or_response.zh_CN: 操作参数或返回内容不符合要求，请核对后重试。
error.invalid_input_or_response.en_US: The request or response was invalid. Check the information and try again.

error.confirmation_required.zh_CN: 本次操作尚未取得有效确认，请检查确认卡片的状态。
error.confirmation_required.en_US: This operation has no valid approval yet. Check the confirmation card's status.

error.confirmation_mismatch.zh_CN: 确认与本次操作不匹配，请检查对应的确认记录。
error.confirmation_mismatch.en_US: The confirmation does not match this operation. Check the corresponding confirmation.

error.confirmation_expired.zh_CN: 本次确认已过期，请重新准备并确认。
error.confirmation_expired.en_US: This confirmation has expired. Prepare and confirm the operation again.

error.confirmation_pending.zh_CN: 本次操作已有关联的确认，请先处理原确认卡片。
error.confirmation_pending.en_US: This operation already has a confirmation. Resolve the original card first.

error.confirmation_unavailable.zh_CN: 当前无法发起确认，请在交互话题中继续操作。
error.confirmation_unavailable.en_US: Confirmation is unavailable here. Continue in an interactive topic.

error.confirmation_stale.zh_CN: 内容或版本已变更，请重新准备并确认。
error.confirmation_stale.en_US: The content or version has changed. Prepare and confirm the operation again.

error.unexpected_error.zh_CN: 操作遇到问题，请稍后重试。
error.unexpected_error.en_US: The operation encountered a problem. Please try again later.

error.resource_files_unavailable.zh_CN: 无法读取所需的项目文件，请检查项目访问权限和文件挂载后重试。
error.resource_files_unavailable.en_US: The required project files are unavailable. Check project access and the file mount before retrying.

error.duplicate_file_id.zh_CN: 选择的文件存在重复，请移除重复项后重试。
error.duplicate_file_id.en_US: The selected files contain duplicates. Remove them and try again.

coverage_limit.zh_CN: 查询最多返回 {{count}} 条记录，不能据此认定已覆盖全部。
coverage_limit.en_US: This search returns at most {{count}} records; complete coverage is not established.

error.execution_config_unavailable.zh_CN: 无法取得可用的任务配置，请检查话题或员工设置。
error.execution_config_unavailable.en_US: Usable task configuration is unavailable. Check topic or Agent settings.

task_failed.zh_CN: 任务执行未完成，请查看话题中的消息或调整任务后重试。
task_failed.en_US: The task did not complete. Check its topic messages or revise the task before retrying.

status.delivered.zh_CN: 已投递（不代表任务完成）

search.scopes.zh_CN: 搜索 {{count}} 个项目目录范围

search.incomplete.zh_CN: 部分项目或目录尚未搜索完，当前结果不代表全部文件。
search.incomplete.en_US: Some project or directory scopes remain unsearched. These results do not cover all files.

search.truncated.zh_CN: 部分匹配文件未展示，请缩小关键词或目录范围；继续下一页无法找回本页省略的匹配项。
search.truncated.en_US: Some matches were omitted. Narrow the keywords or directory scope; continuing the next page will not recover omitted matches.

search.names_only.zh_CN: 按文件名和路径匹配，未搜索文件正文；内容和年份需要打开文件确认。
search.names_only.en_US: Matched file names and paths, not file contents. Open selected files to verify their subject and year.

error.search_unavailable.zh_CN: 此次搜索未能读取任何文件列表，请检查项目访问权限或稍后重试。
error.search_unavailable.en_US: No file lists could be read. Check project access or retry later.

contact.bounded.zh_CN: 部门搜索最多检查 100 条匹配记录，结果可能不完整。
contact.bounded.en_US: Department search checks at most 100 matches; results may be incomplete.
